scope: One frozen three-production/two-owned-test candidate; the sixth binding is an unchanged direct-regression dependency. Boundary checkpoint remains accepted and outside this review.

result.statics: Owner's ordered Black/Ruff/scoped Pyright passed on the frozen candidate.
result.corrected_progress_qualification: Earlier progress messages counted completed nodes as passes. The immutable completed receipt is authoritative: 12 passed and one failed; body-mismatch and evidence-link controls passed.
result.full_29: Held; no complete 29-case or final integration result is claimed.
result.additional_reviewer_execution: No behavioral probe, test suite, factory, native operation or package execution. Source-order evidence is sufficient for the reservation finding. Original source and raw diagnostic bytes were not changed.

findings.observed: The projected/original indexes are built, then line 333 retains each selected original with files.setdefault. Only afterward do lines 334-340 reject the merged file count and aggregate raw bytes. Thus an over-capacity supplemental merge is performed before its count/byte refusal.
findings.impact_and_limits: The final manifest is not returned after rejection, and no write is demonstrated. Existing work reservation precedes index construction; this finding does not claim an unbounded loader or a missing work prepayment for the initial combined iteration. It concerns the explicitly required prospective merged-capacity check.
findings.required: Compute and enforce the exact prospective merged count and raw-byte total before supplemental retention/encoding. Charge existing overlap once and preserve loader classification when identical. Keep immutable-original rejection, bounded work accounting, empty-marker return, strict loader/path policy and post-write hash equality unchanged.
findings.verification: Add four direct project_snapshot controls: count exactly sufficient, count one short, raw bytes exactly sufficient, raw bytes one short. Use deterministic observation to prove short cases refuse before supplemental retention/encoding. Binder-only exhaustion controls do not establish this projection property.

findings.observed: The empty-marker projection is compared to base.proposal_base.snapshot.manifest, an unrecomputed plan snapshot. The fixture reconstructs plan.directories and files but omits the pre-existing application directory created by service_plan. The unchanged loader therefore adds application to missing_paths.
findings.required: Compare the empty-marker result with project_snapshot(base.proposal_base, ()).manifest under the same fixture. Keep the assertion of unchanged default operation, marker retention, category, exact bytes and unmarked exclusion. Do not weaken the loader or suppress missing paths.

findings.classification: Measured critical-path and new-body verification gap
findings.measurement: Owner's retained 13-control diagnostic reports 19/23 body statements, missing 141, 145, 160 and 165; module 112/120 statements and 35/44 branches. These are preliminary counts, not a completed 29-case coverage gate.
findings.policy: AGENTS.md General Unit Test Policy: any new module, class or method targets at least 90% coverage; critical behavior must be tested. Use the established declaration-exclusive BODY reader without augmenting raw counters.
required_controls: Set profile.limits.source_files to exactly the existing captured-file count and select an already captured profile path. Require successful coalescing with unchanged count, category and bytes (line 141).

Use that same exact source_files ceiling plus one new selected legacy file. Require ReportLimitError with zero reader calls (line 145); do not substitute artifact_records and fail at an unrelated work ceiling.
Set document_bytes to exactly the aggregate existing immutable bytes, then select one new file. Require remaining-read refusal before reader use (line 160).
Select an already captured profile path whose physical memory bytes changed to a different same-length value. Require the exact captured-byte conflict with no successful capture or write (line 165).

finite_repair_scope.tests: Correct MT1 and add exactly the four capture plus four projection controls. The proposed cohesive test_migration_capture.py split moves the existing 11 capture nodes and sole helper, preserving old-to-new identity mapping; the nine schema controls remain in test_service_migration.py. Preserve assertions outside MT1 and the authorized additions.
finite_repair_scope.population: Expected focused 37 and final 326 after the eight additions; bind actual collection identities before claiming those totals. Preserve the three approved direct test_mutation_plan selectors and the real guarded migration-write control.
finite_repair_scope.size: Current physical lines: service_bootstrap 354, migration_capture 287, mutation_plan 500, publication test 497, migration test 409. Keep every resulting production/test file at most 500; no additional production file or unrelated refactor is required by this finding.

closed_review.compatible_contract: Public keyword-default-empty marker, trusted per-operation I/O clone, selected original bytes/ordinary observations, both recaptures, exact registered v1 schema identity and pinned evidence revision are consistent with the approved finite contract, subject to MC2-R1 and completed proof.
closed_review.unchanged_boundaries: No init_io/profile-field/PathPolicy/mutation_io changes, no broader roots or grants, no arbitrary unmarked retention. The public marker is not independent authority.
closed_review.default: Source lines 303-304 return the same accepted loader result for the empty marker. MT1 is a fixture operand error, not demonstrated default-loader regression.
closed_review.publication: The existing real migration-write test invokes the actual guarded writer, directly exercising its unchanged projected-versus-recaptured hash postcondition; no extra publication-control node is required by this review.
closed_review.intent_type_size: No additional concrete intent-comment, type, size or API-compatibility finding in the frozen changed scope. Clean static proof does not substitute for remaining behavior and BODY gates.
closed_review.prior_review_qualification: The earlier exact-file-as-documentation-root source-clear claim remains withdrawn by MC1. The current clone/marker correction is independently assessed here; historical failed candidates and all-planned boundary expectation remain preserved, not rewritten.

completion_implications.required: After the finite repair, one clean ordered static/precheck/focused sequence, current BODY/changed-line and prior-covered-point proof, then the actual complete reversed affected final population and four contracts. No acceptance/checkoff now.
completion_implications.package: Runtime source changes require regenerated package identity, build/check/install and a fresh installed identity binding. The earlier package/native records remain historical.
completion_implications.native: Reuse unaffected native operations only with exact unchanged implementation/dependency bindings and explicit empty-marker default-path qualification. Retained native evidence does not prove new supplemental migration behavior. This finite review requires the actual guarded in-memory migration write and fresh package identity, not a default replay of the entire accepted native chain.
